svg.title: Lactifluus: policy-based CDC intelligence for PostgreSQL on Kubernetes
svg.desc: Pipeline from PostgreSQL through Debezium to the Lactifluus operator, with a read-only inspector, three policies, a measured start-up comparison (57 s with an initial snapshot, 6 s with no_data) and a legend of verification status.
